newsitem.title: UK: No building soc conversion under Labour - Knight.
newsitem.headline: No building soc conversion under Labour - Knight.

text.p: Angela Knight, economic secretary to the Treasury (finance ministry), said on Wednesday that Britain's building societies would never have been allowed to convert into public limited companies under a Labour government.

Hailing a "transformation" under which societies such as the Halifax Building Society, Northern Rock, and Woolwich Building Society are ending their mutual status, Knight said: "None of this happened by accident. But changes taking place today are a direct result of Conservative legislation.
"Labour would nevenr have taken those steps."
Knight said that under the ruling Conservative Party, the number of shareholders had already risen from some three million in 1979 to around 10 million.
The figure would rise to 16 million when building society members received free shares on their conversion to public companies, she added.
